answer: Bandwidth admission challenges. Agents serving oasis images, ivory scans, or raven audio must return a fresh random byte stream supplied by the verifier before a deadline. Bind each stream to one account and epoch, count the bytes actually received, and consume its receipt once. N admitted accounts require N separately transferred streams, costing bandwidth even under one operator. This assumes unpredictable incompressible streams and an honest remote verifier; colluding endpoints or subsidized bandwidth weaken the economic barrier.
